rules.appliesWhen: a stylesheet or markup declares a hex colour
rules.evidence: Fired on two of three pilots. Both were arguably right in effect and wrong in reason: the lock console used the colour as ink on a dark ground rather than as a ground, and the seed bank had a legitimately warm paper. Both changed their material and both pages improved. The rule has no notion of what a colour is used for.
rules.override: Choose from the subject own materials, or write the banned-palette-pinned-by-brief line in the direction record. That waiver is only honest when the brief really pinned it.
